source: nfl/sim/game.py simulate_game, plus kicker_model bands for the two kickers

volume_centre.tolerance_rule: 3.0 x Monte Carlo SE of (simulated mean - target) = sd * sqrt(1/n_sims + 1/n_calib), n_calib=1000

NOT_RECONCILED_BY_DESIGN.proj_plays: offensive snaps incl. sacks, penalties, kneels; the simulator models pass+rush attempts -- a different quantity

volume_centre.DISPERSION_UNTOUCHED: per_own_point, per_margin_point and both residual_sd are the measured values; only the two intercepts moved, per club

NOT_SYNTHESISED: no draw is derived from a projected mean. Player draws come from the joint simulator and kicker draws from measured attempt and make rates.
POSTGAME_DESCRIPTIVE: built 2026-10-02 after the game from SHOWDOWN_TONIGHT_PROJ_QBTGT_FIXED.json under the projection-centred arm; descriptive only, no prospective evidence; the delivered artifact is SHOWDOWN_TONIGHT_DRAWS.json
